description:
## Finding
The following doctests are marked \`rust,ignore\` (compile-only when ignored is set off, but with rust,ignore they are skipped entirely — not even compiled):

- \`pkix-chain/src/lib.rs:18\` (covered separately as P1 because it's the marquee example)
- \`pkix-composite/src/lib.rs:17\` (CompositeVerifier example)
- \`pkix-profiles/src/lib.rs:29\` (WebPkiProfile example)
- \`pkix-path/src/lib.rs:316\` (SignatureVerifier impl example)
- \`pkix-path/src/lib.rs:690\` (Profile impl example)

\`cargo test --workspace\` reports them as \`ignored\`.

Other crates already use \`no_run\` correctly: \`pkix-chain-simple/src/lib.rs:425\`, \`pkix-lint\` doctests, \`pkix-lint/src/cabf_tls_br.rs:20,513\`. The \`no_run\` examples compile-test the API.

## Why P3
- API drift (rename, signature change) silently invalidates these examples without test failure.
- These are the canonical onboarding examples for each crate. Compile-checking them prevents stale-doc drift.

## Fix
Convert each \`rust,ignore\` to \`rust,no_run\` and add minimal scaffolding to make the example compile (e.g., \`# fn _x(...) -> Result<()>\`, \`unimplemented!()\`, etc.). The pattern at \`pkix-lint/src/lib.rs:74\` is a clean example.

## Scope reference
The 5 sites above; not including \`pkix-chain/src/lib.rs:18\` which is a separate P1.
title: P3: 5+ rust,ignore doctests should be no_run for compile coverage
